name: Mara M. Sanger
occupation: Carbon County clerk of district court (re-elected November 2026)
prior_offices: Carbon County clerk of district court (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Mara M. Sanger is the Carbon County clerk of district court and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official clerk of district court page lists her in that office. The Rawlins Times reported that she was among the county officials who won at the polls.
